title: Hot Potato
description: A new food item with a twist...
body:
# Hot Potato Mod
This mod adds a new item called The Hot Potato. Be careful, becuase while it might apear to be a normal food item, it can be very dangerous...
## How to Obtain
To get the Hot Potato Item, put a potato in a crafting table along with flint and steal, blaze powder, a fire charge, and a lava bucket.
## Features
- Does damage to players and entities who have the hot potato in their inventory
- Kills players who decide to eat the hot potato
- Funny death messages for hot potato related deaths
